affected_implementation: scripts/v3_2/line_item_evaluation.py and dependent critical-risk construction, replay, tables, figures, reports, governance, and README
correction_required_because: The implementation conflated historical path-occurrence evaluation, positional row evaluation, row matchability, field accuracy, and benign row permutation. This inflated row-failure and critical monetary-risk labels.

defects.A_E0_IMPLEMENTATION_MISMATCH: The protocol intended historical v3.1 path/occurrence comparison with row identity discarded, but E0 was computed from strict positional row pairs and E1 was set equal to E0.
defects.B_BENIGN_PERMUTATION_CONFLATED: assignment_changed = any(g != p for g,p in pairs) and alignment_error = assignment_changed or optimal_weight > strict_weight incorrectly marked harmless permutations of complete equivalent rows as failures.
defects.C_CRITICAL_TARGET_INFLATION: The critical target added a monetary penalty merely because the optimal row assignment differed from positional assignment.
defects.D_E2_NAMING: E2_line_item_f1 measured accepted matched-row counts and did not by itself describe field correctness. Row matchability and matched-field accuracy must be reported separately.

corrected_definitions.E0: Discard menu row identity and list indices; group normalized values by semantic path and compare repeated values in historical occurrence order.
corrected_definitions.E1: Pair GT row i with predicted row i and compute field precision, recall, and F1 within positional pairs.
corrected_definitions.E2_row_matchability: Use maximum-weight bipartite matching and report matched, unmatched GT, and spurious predicted rows independently from field accuracy.
corrected_definitions.E2_matched_field_accuracy: Compute field precision, recall, and micro F1 inside accepted E2 row correspondences.
corrected_definitions.row_permutation_only: Assignment differs from position, every accepted E2 row is exact, and no GT or predicted row is unmatched; it is neither extraction error nor critical monetary error.
corrected_definitions.row_semantic_association_error: Assignment differs, the case is not permutation-only, and matched structure retains a field/association inconsistency; diagnostic only and adds no standalone monetary penalty.
corrected_definitions.critical_monetary_loss: Count only missing, spurious, or incorrect comparable monetary fields in document fields, matched rows, unmatched GT rows, or unmatched predicted rows. Row index or assignment change alone contributes zero.

evidence_to_regenerate: risk candidates and frozen-algorithm selection replay
slices, robustness sensitivity, figures, reports, governance, and README
